content: I used 6.9.2 from https://github.com/prusa3d/Prusa-Firmware-Buddy/releases/tag/v6.9.2 - after flashing it detected the INDX automatically and then started the wizard.
I had the same issue as Stephen. Go to Prusa CORE One/+ INDX support page, and get THAT firmware.  I only had the Core One/+/Gen2 firmware.

um COREONEINDX was not listed as an option and I definitely have this driver https://help.prusa3d.com/product/core-one-indx flashed...
It gave me the option of the COREONEGEN2 but I can't go back from the calibration screen to get to that...
